description: This file defines classes related to shape descriptors in OrchardCore, including FeatureShapeDescriptor, ShapeDescriptorIndex, and ShapeDescriptor, which manage shape metadata, placement, and bindings for display management.

classes.name: FeatureShapeDescriptor
classes.description: Represents a shape descriptor associated with a feature, holding feature info and shape type.

classes.name: ShapeDescriptorIndex
classes.description: A composite shape descriptor that manages multiple alteration descriptors, wrappers, and async callbacks for shape processing.

classes.name: ShapeDescriptor
classes.description: Base class for shape descriptors, managing shape type, bindings, placement, and display lifecycle callbacks.

classes.name: ShapeBinding
classes.description: Represents a binding for a shape, including its name, source, and async binding function.

methods.name: DefaultPlacementAction
methods.description: Provides default placement info based on the DefaultPlacement property.
